title: Your epitaph is written
html_source: Suggests Robert Emmet’s last words: “Let no man write my epitaph; for as no man who knows my motives dares now vindicate them, let not prejudice or ignorance asperse them.” Neither Bloom’s nor Joyce’s motives are known. One who does know would not dare defend them, likely, out of fear that the interpretation would garner ridicule, therefore nor he who knows not, nor he who dares not say should condemn them.
